<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Hell of 1,000,000 Needles](/Feats.aspx?ID=4265) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 31

</column>

---

The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal. The needles lance into a cube 30 feet on a side within 500 feet. Each creature in the area takes 13d6 piercing damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. Each creature that fails its save is impaled, becoming [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (the DC is your class DC); a creature that critically failed is also [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) as long as it's impaled.

 The hell remains until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. The first time you Sustain it each round, lightning crisscrosses the needles. Each creature in the area takes 3d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. Squares in the area are [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=454). A creature takes 6 piercing damage for every square of the area it moves through.

---
**Level (20th)** The initial damage is 17d6, and the hazardous terrain damage is 7.
name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles
